questions.stem: Let $X=\{x\in\mathbb{Z} : -4\le x\le 2\}$, so $X$ is a set of integers. The product $X\times X$ is drawn as points on a perpendicular graphical net. How many of the points of $X\times X$ lie on the axes (that is, have $x=0$ or $y=0$)?

canonical_solution.text_md: X has 7 elements: the integers from -4 to 2, including 0.
Points on the x-axis have y = 0 and any x in X: 7 points. Points on the y-axis have x = 0 and any y in X: 7 points.
The point (0, 0) is counted twice, so the total is 7 + 7 - 1 = 13.
